title: The Second Voyage of Sindbad
summary: Sindbad continued his chronicle on the second day:
full_text:
Sindbad continued his chronicle on the second day:

'Growing restless in Baghdad, I set forth on a second voyage. One afternoon, while strolling on an uninhabited island surrounded by singing birds, sleep overcame me beneath a shady bough. When I awoke, the ship had sailed away, leaving me stranded and alone.

I climbed a tall tree and beheld a gigantic white dome rising above the forest. Approaching it, I found it had no doors, and its surface was as smooth as polished ivory. Suddenly, the sky darkened; looking up, I saw an immense bird of monstrous size—the legendary Rukh! The white dome was its egg, and the bird settled upon it to brood.

With daring resolve, I unbound my heavy linen turban, tied myself securely to the giant leg of the bird, and waited through the night. At dawn, the Rukh leaped into the sky with a roar of wind, carrying me high above the clouds, landing at last in a deep, sheer ravine surrounded by inaccessible cliffs.

I untied myself and looked around: the floor of the valley was paved with diamonds of immense size, but the ravine was infested with monstrous vipers that hid in caves by day to escape the Rukh!

Presently, huge carcasses of slaughtered sheep came tumbling down from the cliffs above, thrown by diamond hunters who used the meat to gather gems: the diamonds stuck to the raw flesh, and when the giant eagles carried the meat to their aeries, the hunters frightened the birds away to collect the jewels!

I filled my pockets and turban with the largest diamonds I could find, tied myself to the back of a fat carcass with my turban cord, and waited. A giant eagle swooped down, seized the meat in its talons, and bore me up to its nest on the cliff summit!

When the diamond hunter arrived to frighten the eagle away, he was astonished to find a living man tied to the meat. I shared my diamonds with him, boarded his ship, and returned to Baghdad wealthier than before.'
moral: Resourceful ingenuity and fearless resolve find a way out of the most hopeless abysses.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Second Voyage of Sindbad"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
